reason: E1 shows short-range ordering and strain in HEA nanoparticles, supporting the first premise, but neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence linking ordering/strain to delayed premelting or a sharper melting transition, leaving the core mechanistic premises unsupported.
premises: HEA nanoparticles exhibit short-range chemical ordering and internal lattice strain
Short-range ordering and strain kinetically stabilize surface atoms, delaying premelting
Stabilization sharpens the melting transition relative to a random solid solution
Degree of ordering can be controlled and quantified via synthesis conditions and STEM-EDX/NMF
Premelting onset and melting steepness correlate with degree of ordering and strain
